title: CultureBERT: Measuring Corporate Culture With Transformer-Based Language Models
reasoning: The paper measures corporate culture using the Competing Values Framework (CVF) which includes organizational values like 'clan,' 'hierarchy,' 'adhocracy,' and 'market.' While these are values, they are specifically in an organizational context and do not encompass the broader scope of religion, faith, morals, or ethics as a core evaluation component for LLMs.
